decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 7th November 2006, the erection of a roof extension, including rear dormer and raising of the existing flat roof to loft area to the existing house with 4.20m projection, 2.55m high at the top not exceeding the roofline of the original house, 1.75m wide, with the raising of the existing flat roof by 0.275m not exceeding the roofline of the original house was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls inside the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class B of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the proposed extension has a volume of under 50cubic metres.

Condition : 2 - Informatives: 
1.	The proposed roof extension must not be higher than any part of the existing ridge of the roof. The original ridgeline and ridge capping of the house should be maintained.

2.	The roof lights hereby permitted shall be flush with the existing plane of the roof.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of a roof extension, including rear dormer and raising of the existing flat roof to loft area to the existing house
